tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List the vtiger modules (entity types) the authenticated developer is allowed to access.

tools.name: describe_module
tools.description: Describe a module's live fields: names, labels, mandatory flags, types, picklist values and reference targets. Call this before create/update to learn the exact field names (the schema is customized).

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only VTQL SELECT (SQL-like). Results are already filtered to what the developer may see. Example: SELECT tc_code, date_start, totaltime FROM TimeControl LIMIT 10;

vtql.description: A VTQL SELECT statement. Include a LIMIT. Must start with SELECT.

tools.name: retrieve_record
tools.description: Fetch one record by its vtiger webservice id (e.g. '17x1234').

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Create a record in any module the developer can write to. Provide field values as an object; use describe_module first to get exact field names. Reference fields (owners, related records) take webservice ids.

values.description: Field name -> value map for the new record.

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update fields on an existing record (partial update — only supplied fields change). Uses vtiger 'revise'.

id.description: Webservice id of the record to update.

tools.name: delete_record
tools.description: Delete a record by webservice id. Disabled unless the server was started with VTIGER_ALLOW_DELETE=true.

id.description: Webservice id of the record to delete.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated developer's vtiger user id and profile info.

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: List projects the developer can access (id + name), to pick a project for timesheet logging.

tools.name: list_my_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (id + name) the developer can access in the ProjectTask module. Optionally filter by a task-name fragment. The task id is what a timesheet's link field points to.

nameContains.description: Optional substring to match against the task name.

tools.name: log_timesheet
tools.description: Log a daily timesheet entry in the TimeControl module for the developer. Resolves a task by name or id, defaults the date to today and the owner to the current user, and computes total time from start/end when not given.

date.description: Entry date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

task.description: Task name (searched) or webservice id, linked as the entry's related field.

totalTime.description: Explicit total HH:MM; computed from start/end if omitted.

hoursType.description: Picklist value, e.g. 'Regular Hours' or 'Extra Hours'.

tools.name: list_my_timesheets
tools.description: List the developer's own timesheet entries, optionally within a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: update_timesheet
tools.description: Update fields on an existing TimeControl timesheet entry (partial update).

id.description: Webservice id of the TimeControl record.
